title: From Precision Illusion to Calibration Intervention: A Framework for Evaluating and Correcting LLM Uncertainty Expression in Safety-Critical Advice

citation.mla: Guo, Baixin. "From Precision Illusion to Calibration Intervention: A Framework for Evaluating and Correcting LLM Uncertainty Expression in Safety-Critical Advice." Manuscript in preparation, 2026.

abstract: This manuscript reports a controlled descriptive comparison on one fixed 40-case constructed fitness-advice corpus. Generic and Generic+Oracle revision produced identical per-case decisions in this single execution. CheckMyCoach routes candidate calibration failures to correction and validates the revised outputs; no delivered output passed every deterministic check. The study contains no human validation and does not establish system superiority, validated detection, equivalence, or user-level effects.
